definitions.explanation: Refers to the approximate midpoint of a time period such as a month, century, or season. Used to indicate a vague point in time that falls around the center of a given span.

examples.japanese: {三月|さんがつ}{中頃|なかごろ}に{届|とど}く{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: It is expected to arrive around the middle of March.

examples.japanese: {今週|こんしゅう}の{中頃|なかごろ}までに{返事|へんじ}をします。
examples.english: I will reply by around the middle of this week.

examples.japanese: {江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}の{中頃|なかごろ}から、{町人|ちょうにん}{文化|ぶんか}が{栄|さか}えるようになった。
examples.english: From around the middle of the Edo period, townspeople culture began to flourish.

notes:
USAGE: {中頃|なかごろ} is attached directly to time period words. It is more vague than {中旬|ちゅうじゅん}, which specifically means the 11th-20th of a month.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～{月|がつ}{中頃|なかごろ} (around the middle of ~ month)
- {来月|らいげつ}{中頃|なかごろ} (around the middle of next month)
- ～{世紀|せいき}の{中頃|なかごろ} (around the middle of the ~ century)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {中旬|ちゅうじゅん}: specifically the 11th-20th of a month (more precise)
- {半|なか}ば: also means "around the middle" but can apply to non-time contexts too
